issue_request: Published / Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 issue asking why contained resources could omit an explicit subject and rely on parent-resource context; the approved resolution was to disallow such inheritance and state that contained resources do not inherit any values from their context.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 5814. In git, commit 6bb9d508d3 changed source/references.html for the linked FHIR-7366/FHIR-7385 decision by making the contained-resource section say inline contained resources do not inherit context from their parent resource.
additional_context: FHIR-7385 is the linked Published companion with the same resolution and already has a combined-branch reconciliation commit, ee09fbb1af, that changed the page introduction from treating contained resources as an exception to saying they follow the same no-inheritance rule. FHIR-50639 is an unresolved later tracker that reported the now-removed contradiction and is background only. source/fhir.ini maps reference=references, confirming references.html is in current build scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/references.html now says contained resources follow the same no-inheritance rule and that a contained resource does not implicitly share the parent's subject; this preserves the FHIR-7366 decision without redundant prose or deciding unresolved follow-up work.
